assets.label: Fig4
assets.caption: Figure 4. Grid (left) and spiral (right) shifting strategies for the HEAL-SWIN transformer, projected onto the plane for visualiza- tion. The grid lines outline the eight base pixels used for this dataset, arrows indicate the directions in which pixels move. High- lighted regions are masked in the attention layers. Note that in grid shifting, pixels at boundaries of colliding base pixels are moved to the outer edge. In ring shifting, distortions are introduced towards the pole (center). For better visibility, the amount of shifting in these images is exaggerated.
